svg.text: master inverter, pass gate, slave feedback
F11 dffrnq_1: controller flip-flop with reset (b, start_meta, run); the other 36 use dffnrnq_1
Same plan as F07 with a NAND in each loop: RN = 0 forces both NANDs to output 1, so net4 = 1 and Q = 0 whatever the clock does.
Master loop: net1 -> inverter -> net2 -> NAND(net2, RN) -> net1. Slave: NAND(net8, RN) -> net4 -> Q = NOT net4.
Rails: VDD at the top, VSS at the bottom; every PMOS body is on VDD and every NMOS body on VSS (drawn inside the symbol). A dot marks a connection; wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
